texts.content:
The possessed that grow into giant forms become siege-class
units within the swarm. Their bodies expand
disproportionately, reinforced by layers of external vascular
tissue and ossified plating that serve as partial armor.

These creatures are not only defined by brute strength,
but by an accelerated metabolism that allows partial
regeneration after sustaining damage.

They typically manifest a massive serrated weapon
(assembled from reconfigured bone and cartilage)
capable of cleaving through large structures and
consuming entire bodies in a single strike.

They absorb biomass from the environment or fallen
prey to rebuild limbs, seal wounds, or even alter the
ir form mid-combat. Their presence on the battlefield
demands immediate tactical response, as they
can destabilize defenses, crush formations,
and spread chaos with every movement.
